results.question: 状态为「已完成」的订单一共有多少笔？
results.lastSql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成'

results.question: 2025 年 2 月单月的「已完成」销售额是多少？
results.lastSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.created_at >= '2025-02-01' AND o.created_at <= '2025-02-28'

results.question: 近 30 天的「已完成」销售额是多少？
results.lastSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND o.created_at >= '2026-08-02' AND o.created_at <= '2026-08-31'

results.question: 华东地区客户的「已完成」销售额是多少？
results.lastSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) AS total_sales_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN customers c ON c.id = o.customer_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' AND c.region = '华东'

results.question: 一笔订单如果包含多个分类的商品，会在每个分类下都计入一笔。按这个规则，各分类各有多少笔「已完成」订单涉及？
results.lastSql: SELECT p.category, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS order_count FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY p.category ORDER BY order_count DESC

results.question: 平均每笔订单消费多少钱？
results.lastSql: SELECT SUM(oi.amount) / COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) AS avg_order_value FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成'

results.question: 员工的平均工资是多少？
哪 3 个下单渠道的已完成订单最多？
results.lastSql: SELECT COALESCE(channel, '未知') AS channel, COUNT(*) AS completed_orders FROM orders WHERE status = '已完成' GROUP BY COALESCE(channel, '未知') ORDER BY completed_orders DESC LIMIT 3

results.question: 金额最大的 5 笔已完成订单各花了多少钱？
results.lastSql: SELECT o.id AS order_id, SUM(oi.amount) AS total_amount FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.id WHERE o.status = '已完成' GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT 5
